notes: Assembled from the booklet with the parts list as the authority. Every type appears exactly the listed number of times (104 pieces).

Connectivity fix: the earlier graph wrote other_joins endpoints as 'id:port', which were not read as piece ids and left 23 separate groups. Endpoints are now bare piece ids and the port names are in the method text. Every pin, hinge, axle, clip, sideways, wheel, tyre and sticker connection is now a real edge. The model is one connected build.

Several pieces are hidden between booklet frames or drawn at ambiguous angles, so some rests_on lists are best guesses. This applies mostly to the grey plates stacked on the rear section (b18-b30), the hinge and chassis plates in steps 1-4, and the pins and links around the boom.
The minifigure on page 3 (legs, torso, head, helmet) is not in the parts list, so it is not included.
The bumper sub-assembly (b54-b65) is built flat and joined sideways to the side studs of the 1x4 brick b36, so b54 has an empty rests_on and a sideways other_join.
The yellow 1x2 plates b43 and b44 are joined sideways to the side studs of the headlight bricks b41 and b42, so their rests_on is empty.
Wheels, tyres, bucket, bushes, axle, pins and clips attach by pin, axle, hinge or clip, so their rests_on is empty.
The sticker sheet b104 has no position. It is applied to the two 1x3 bricks (b37, b38) and the two curved bricks (b64, b65).
The pin ports on the links are assumed: pin-hole.1 and pin-hole.9 are the end holes, and pin-hole.5 is the middle hole that takes the axle.
